title: Wandering Wears
description: Sewing, Nether Progression, and Wandering Trader Themed equipment
body:
## Wandering Wears
- Three new armors with pretty looks and balanced stats 
  - Wandering Robes
  - Scrap Armor
  - Ornate Netherite Armor
- New Crafting Mechanics
  - Added sewing kits and cloth to use in sewing recipes
  - Added the copper tinkering tools to help break down resources for more advanced recipes
- Recipe Tweaks
  - New balanced and fun recipes trees have been added to make the game more interactive and rewarding
(Recomended that you play with a recipe vewer mod)
